title: scheffleropsis polyandra
intro: Scheffleropsis polyandra, commonly known as the Himalayan blue poppy, is a rare and endangered flowering plant native to the Himalayan region. The Himalayan blue poppy is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to treat anxiety, insomnia, and other mood disorders due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The bioactive constituents of Scheffleropsis polyandra include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
